summary_zh: 泰國今日：50億泰銖有機肥投資因法規審批受阻，部分工廠已關閉；商業部要求業者在能源與運輸成本上升下緩漲價，壓縮製造商利潤。環保稽查與廢棄物管控持續升溫，化學廢棄物再利用成為話題；雀巢則投資230億泰銖興建新咖啡廠，顯示投資仍在進行。
summary_en: Thailand: regulatory delays stalled a THB5bn organic fertiliser investment and closed some plants; the Commerce Ministry urges producers to hold prices despite rising energy and transport costs. Environmental compliance pressure keeps rising, while Nestlé breaks ground on a THB23bn coffee plant.
